title: Juicy Tender Canadian Beef Skewers
description: A malty, tender, and festive Canadian dish featuring canola oil and papillote, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together canola oil, malt vinegar, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Wrap each skewer in a sheet of papillote paper, twisting the ends to seal.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the beef skewers hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
